summaries.semantic_outcome: Native Debian ARM64 Dolphin 2503, motionplus, with a private synthetic caller EEPROM image, enumerates the virtual Remote through HIDAPI and adds its ControllerInterface device according to its own notice log. The 10-byte base calibration read at 0x0016 succeeds and own-log base failures disappear. The consumer then repeatedly sends speaker-mute output 0x19 and expires handlers; no native MotionPlus calibration read is observed in the bound. Speaker behavior remains D7-gated and unchanged. Mapping UI and decoded motion are unobserved; raw reports and device addition are not decoded gyro acceptance. No physical compatibility or radio operation is inferred.
